# Linked Canvas in practice

> [!summary] One Markdown note becomes both a quick reading map and a persistent visual workspace.

## Start from a question

> Release UX verified locally.


Open [[Research question]], compare it with [[Evidence]], and keep the current decision visible.

![[workflow.svg]]

![[brief.pdf]]

## Working rule

- Markdown and attachments own content.
- Canvas owns position, size, groups, and visual-only connections.
- Linked Canvas adds only the link-aware projection.

| Surface | Best use |
| --- | --- |
| Linked Map | Follow one useful branch while reading |
| Linked Canvas | Arrange a durable project or research board |
